create.name: Miriam Peretz
create.bio:
Miriam Peretz is a dancer and teacher of sacred movement whose work centres on Central Asian dance and the devotional turning of Sufi whirling. Raised among people she describes as mystics and practising as a dervish herself, she studied dance and choreography at Saint Mary's College of California and Mills College, studied Central Asian dance and percussion for three years in Jerusalem, and trained with teachers in Tajikistan, Uzbekistan, Turkey, Morocco and elsewhere. She danced for many years as a principal with Ballet Afsaneh and other companies.

Out of this background she developed Nava Dance and Nava Movement, practices that pair traditional Persian, Tajik, Uzbek and Afghan forms with breath, ritual, improvisation and circle dances, treating the dance floor as a place of prayer and community. She teaches a weekly Nava Dance class in person and on Zoom, offers private sessions and ritual for rites of passage, and runs an online school with a twelve-class foundation course. She also leads the Nava Dance Collective, an international group of women dancers, and holds retreats and immersions in places such as Turkey and Crete, as well as women's retreats at the Omega Institute.

courses.title: Nava Dance - Live & Live Zoom (Fridays)
courses.description: Miriam's weekly Nava Dance class, held in person and online. Each class opens with breath and movement ritual, then moves through circle dance and sequences drawn from Persian, Tajik, Uzbek and Afghan traditions.

courses.title: Nava Dance - Technique Level 1
courses.description: A self-paced, twelve-class online course in the foundations of Nava Dance, built around Persian themes and Miriam's ritual warm-ups. It is the core course of her online school.

courses.title: Private Session with Miriam (Live or via Zoom)
courses.description: One-to-one sessions in Nava Dance, Central Asian styles or sacred dance practice, in person or online. Miriam also creates rituals for celebrations and rites of passage.
